description: This file defines the StandingInstructionDuesData class, which models data related to dues from standing instructions in the financial application. It contains fields for due date and total due amount, along with a parameterized constructor and accessor methods.

classes.name: StandingInstructionDuesData
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the due date and total amount due for a standing instruction in the account management context.

methods.name: StandingInstructionDuesData
methods.description: Constructor initializing dueDate and totalDueAmount fields.

methods.description: Returns the due date of the standing instruction dues.
